what_happened: In job cgq9, the user corrected Athena's first reading before work began. The job is part of the move of records/ readers to a records worktree. The reading put the test for the xtask walltime reader in crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs. That cannot work, because xtask has no library target and athena-cli cannot depend on it. The user said the test must live inside xtask. The user also added a requirement for the land_pr, audit and status tests: the worktree records and the in-tree records must have distinct job ids or values, and the test must assert that the worktree's value is returned. Without that, a test cannot tell which source was read.
cause: The reading is built from the request text and is not checked against the workspace structure or the test design. Nothing checks that a test's chosen location can import the code it targets, which is the same gap the planning-stage class 20261026-155850-0ksw describes, only here it appears earlier, in the reading. Nothing requires a test for a "reads from the new location" change to use fixtures that differ between the old and new sources. A test whose worktree and in-tree data are identical passes whichever source is read. Only the user knows these facts, so the same correction recurs on each reading in the records/ move family.
prevention: Add a reading check before acceptance with two parts. (1) For each test location named in a criterion, resolve the crate and confirm that it can depend on or import the target, using the workspace manifests, for example by refusing a test under athena-cli for code in a crate with no library target. (2) For any criterion that a reader now uses a new source, require the criterion to say that the old and new sources hold distinct values and that the test asserts the new source's value. Reject readings that omit either part.
proposed_request: Move the xtask walltime reader to read records from the records worktree. Put its test inside xtask, not in crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs, because xtask has no library target and athena-cli cannot depend on it. For the land_pr, audit and status tests, give the worktree records and the in-tree records distinct job ids or values, and assert that the value from the worktree is the one returned. Acceptance: (1) the xtask walltime test runs under xtask and fails if the reader reads the in-tree records; (2) the land_pr, audit and status tests each fail if the reader reads the in-tree records instead of the worktree; (3) no test depends on xtask from athena-cli; (4) the full test suite passes.
